name: Jennie Morton
mentions: Miss Jennie Morton of South Heart, was married last week to a fireman whose name we are unable to learn.

…have again been misled by rumor into publishing a notice of a marriage that has not taken place. Miss Jennie Morton of South Heart, was the victim of the rumor this time and as we have the same power of divorcing that we have of marrying, we declare the banns to be broken.
